requirements.text: The lower legform impactor shall be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during rebound of the impactor.
requirements.quote: The impactor shall be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during rebound of the impactor.

requirements.text: For each test the foam flesh shall be two new sheets of 25 mm thick foam type CF-45 or equivalent, which shall be cut from the sheet of material used for the dynamic certification test.
requirements.quote: For each test the foam flesh shall be two new sheets of 25 mm thick foam type CF-45 or equivalent, which shall be cut from the sheet of material used for the dynamic certification test.

requirements.text: The skin shall be a 1.5 mm thick fibre reinforced rubber sheet.

requirements.text: The mass of the foam and the rubber skin together shall be 0.6 kg ± 0.1 kg, excluding any reinforcement, mountings, etc. which are used to attach the rear edges of the rubber skin to the rear member.
requirements.quote: The mass of the foam and the rubber skin together shall be 0.6 kg ± 0.1 kg (this excludes any reinforcement, mountings, etc. which are used to attach the rear edges of the rubber skin to the rear member).

requirements.text: The foam shall be of such a size and shape that an adequate gap is maintained between the foam and components behind the front member, to avoid significant load paths between the foam and these components.
requirements.quote: The foam shall be of such a size and shape that an adequate gap is maintained between the foam and components behind the front member, to avoid significant load paths between the foam and these components.

requirements.text: The selected measuring points on the front bumper shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The selected measuring points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: A minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: A minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: The selected measuring points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The selected measuring points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: Upper legform to bumper tests shall be to different types of structure, where they vary throughout the bumper test area to be assessed.
requirements.quote: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where they vary throughout the area to be assessed.

requirements.text: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact.

requirements.text: The tolerance to the direction of impact shall be ±2°.
requirements.quote: The tolerance to this direction is ±2°.

requirements.quote: At the time of first contact the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance

requirements.text: The impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm.
requirements.quote: the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm.

requirements.text: The tolerance to the direction of impact of the upper legform impactor shall be ±2°.
requirements.quote: The tolerance to this direction is ±2°.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.quote: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: Three tests each shall be carried out with the child headform impactor to the middle and the outer thirds of the child/small adult test areas, at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: with three tests each to the middle and the outer thirds of the child/small adult test areas, at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: Where possible, at least one of the nine child headform tests shall be carried out on the windscreen test area.
requirements.quote: Where possible, at least one of these nine tests shall be carried out on the windscreen test area.

requirements.quote: For each test on the windscreen an undamaged and untested windscreen shall be used.

requirements.text: Child headform tests shall be to different types of structure, where these vary throughout the area to be assessed and at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where these vary throughout the area to be assessed and at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: The direction of impact of child headform tests to the front structure shall be downward and rearward.
requirements.quote: The direction of impact of tests to the front structure shall be downward and rearward.

requirements.text: Where possible, at least one of the nine adult headform tests shall be carried out on the windscreen test area.
requirements.quote: Where possible, at least one of these nine tests shall be carried out on the windscreen test area.

requirements.text: For each adult headform test on the windscreen test area, an undamaged and untested windscreen shall be used.
requirements.quote: For each test on the windscreen an undamaged and untested windscreen shall be used.

requirements.text: The adult headform tests shall be carried out on different types of structure, where these vary throughout the area to be assessed and at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where these vary throughout the area to be assessed and at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: A minimum of nine tests shall be carried out with the adult headform impactor over the adult areas prescribed by the adult bonnet top test area and the adult windscreen test area together.
requirements.quote: A minimum of nine tests shall be carried out with the adult headform impactor, over the adult areas prescribed by the adult bonnet top test area and the adult windscreen test area together

requirements.text: Three tests each shall be carried out with the adult headform impactor to the middle and the outer thirds of the adult test areas, at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: with three tests each to the middle and the outer thirds of the adult test areas, at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: The selected measuring points for the adult headform impactor shall be a minimum of 165 mm apart.
requirements.quote: The selected measuring points for the adult headform impactor shall be a minimum of 165 mm apart and within the adult headform test areas defined in paragraphs 2.1. and 2.44. of this UN Regulation.

requirements.text: The selected measuring points for the adult headform impactor shall be within the adult headform test areas defined in paragraphs 2.1. and 2.44. of this UN Regulation.
requirements.quote: The selected measuring points for the adult headform impactor shall be a minimum of 165 mm apart and within the adult headform test areas defined in paragraphs 2.1. and 2.44. of this UN Regulation.

requirements.quote: These minimum distances are to be set with a flexible tape held tautly along the outer surface of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The adult headform test measuring points shall not be located so that the adult headform impactor will impact the test area with a glancing blow resulting in a more severe second impact outside the test area.
requirements.quote: No measuring point shall be located so that the impactor will impact the test area with a glancing blow resulting in a more severe second impact outside the test area.

requirements.text: The adult headform velocity at the time of impact shall be 9.7 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: The direction of impact shall be in the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle to be tested at an angle of 65° ± 2° to the horizontal.
requirements.quote: The direction of impact shall be in the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle to be tested at an angle of 65° ± 2° to the horizontal.

requirements.quote: The direction of impact of tests to the front structure shall be downward and rearward.

requirements.text: When the flexible lower legform impactor is used for a test according to paragraph 1.3.3. below, the absolute value of the maximum bending moment of the tibia at Tibia-2 shall be 187 Nm ≤ 219 Nm.

requirements.text: When the flexible lower legform impactor is used for a test according to paragraph 1.3.3. below, the absolute value of the maximum bending moment of the tibia at Tibia-3 shall be 139 Nm ≤ 166 Nm.
requirements.quote: (c) Tibia-3 shall be 139 Nm ≤ 166 Nm;

requirements.text: When the flexible lower legform impactor is used for a test according to paragraph 1.3.3. below, the absolute value of the maximum bending moment of the tibia at Tibia-4 shall be 90 Nm ≤ 111 Nm.
requirements.quote: (d) Tibia-4 shall be 90 Nm ≤ 111 Nm.

requirements.text: When the flexible lower legform impactor is used for a test according to paragraph 1.3.3. below, the absolute value of the maximum elongation of MCL shall be 20.5 ≤ 24.0 mm.
requirements.quote: (a) MCL shall be 20.5 ≤ 24.0 mm;

requirements.text: When the flexible lower legform impactor is used for a test according to paragraph 1.3.3. below, the absolute value of the maximum elongation of ACL shall be 8.0 mm ≤ 10.5 mm.

requirements.text: When the flexible lower legform impactor is used for a test according to paragraph 1.3.3. below, the absolute value of the maximum elongation of PCL shall be 3.5 mm ≤ 5.0 mm.
requirements.quote: (c) PCL shall be 3.5 mm ≤ 5.0 mm.

requirements.quote: For all these values for the maximum bending moment and the maximum elongation, the readings used shall be from the initial impact timing to 200 ms after the impact timing.

requirements.text: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.

requirements.quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.

requirements.text: When a force of 10 daN is exerted at their most salient point in any direction in a plane approximately parallel to the surface on which they are mounted, the added ornaments which project more than 10 mm from their support shall retract, become detached or bend over.
requirements.quote: Added ornaments which project more than 10 mm from their support shall retract, become detached or bend over under a force of 10 daN exerted at their most salient point in any direction in a plane approximately parallel to the surface on which they are mounted.

requirements.quote: After the ornaments are retracted, detached or bent over, the remaining projections shall not project more than 10 mm.

requirements.text: The jacking brackets and exhaust pipe(s) shall not project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line lying vertically above them, except that an exhaust pipe may project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line, so long as it terminates in rounded edges, the minimum radius of curvature being 2.5 mm.
requirements.quote: The jacking brackets and exhaust pipe(s) shall not project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line lying vertically above them. As an exception to this requirement an exhaust pipe may project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line, so long as it terminates in rounded edges, the minimum radius of curvature being 2.5 mm.

requirements.text: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, provided that the distance between consecutive elements does not exceed 40 mm and provided that the grilles and gaps have a functional purpose.
requirements.quote: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, provided that the distance between consecutive elements does not exceed 40 mm and provided that the grilles and gaps have a functional purpose.

requirements.quote: For gaps of between 40 mm and 25 mm the radii of curvature shall be 1 mm or more.

requirements.quote: However, if the distance between two consecutive elements is equal to or less than 25 mm, the radii of curvature of external faces of the elements shall not be less than 0.5 mm.

requirements.quote: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap shall be blunted.
requirements.quote: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap shall be blunted.

requirements.quote: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling.

requirements.quote: 5.4.2. the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle prescribed in paragraph 5.4.1.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle shall meet the following requirements:.
requirements.quote: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle shall meet the following requirements:

requirements.quote: The lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly and to remain visible.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the lighting and signalling devices of the vehicle shall remain visible.
requirements.quote: The lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly and to remain visible.

requirements.quote: The vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner;

requirements.quote: The vehicle\u2019s fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning;

requirements.quote: The vehicle\u2019s fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning;

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's sealing devices and caps shall be operable in the normal manner.
requirements.quote: their sealing devices and caps shall be operable in the normal manner.

requirements.quote: The vehicle's exhaust system shall not suffer any damage or displacement which would prevent its normal function.

requirements.text: The vehicle bearing an approval mark as prescribed under this Regulation shall conform to the vehicle type approved, particularly as regards features which influence the behaviour of the parts of the structure and the components affected by impact.
requirements.quote: Every vehicle bearing an approval mark as prescribed under this Regulation shall conform to the vehicle type approved, particularly as regards features which influence the behaviour of the parts of the structure and the components affected by impact.

requirements.text: The front wheels of the vehicle shall be in the straight-ahead position.
requirements.quote: The front wheels shall be in the straight-ahead position.

requirements.text: The first contact of the impactor with the vehicle shall be by the impact contour on the protective device.
requirements.quote: The first contact of the impactor with the vehicle shall be by the impact contour on the protective device.

requirements.text: For the impacts on the front and rear surfaces, the median plane of the impactor for the second impact shall be at a distance at least 300 mm from the first.

requirements.quote: provided that during these impacts the extremities of the impactor do not pass outside a zone defined by two planes parallel to the longitudinal median plane and passing through the corners of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: The vehicle should be impacted at a speed of 2.5 km/h +0.1/-0

requirements.text: If the protective devices include self-restoring materials, the permitted recovery time between tests shall be as stated by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: If the protective devices include self-restoring materials, the permitted recovery time between tests shall be as stated by the manufacturer.

regulations.rationale: R42 governs the low-speed collision behaviour of the front protective device of M1 vehicles, which this front bumper is. (lexical: term match score 2.4)
Pedestrian safety for M1 vehicles requires the front bumper lower leg impact zone to meet legform and energy-absorption performance, so this product must fulfil it. (lexical: term match score 9.6)
External projections of M1 vehicles cover bodywork such as the bumper cover, so the bumper must limit injury risk from contact with its surface. (lexical: term match score 5.7)

Pedestrian safety GTR covers the lower legform and bumper impact zone of M1 vehicles, which this bumper's lower leg impact zone must meet in markets using GTR 9 rather than R127. (lexical: term match score 15.7)
Frontal collision regulation addresses occupant protection in the vehicle, and the bumper is only a contributing structure. (lexical: term match score 0.7)
Road illumination devices are not part of this bumper, though fog lamp housings could be integrated. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
